Ways to enjoy the pantry.

Quick ideas for breakfast, snacking and parties. Add the AIVAR ingredients to your enquiry list in one tap.

DateGo banana toast

5 minutes, serves 1

How to make it
  1. Toast a thick slice of bread.
  2. Spread a generous layer of DateGo Classic.
  3. Top with sliced banana and a pinch of cinnamon.

Peri peri party mix

5 minutes, serves 4

How to make it
  1. Tip peri peri makhana into a big bowl.
  2. Add roasted peanuts and a squeeze of lime.
  3. Toss and serve straight away.

Cocoa date smoothie

5 minutes, serves 1

How to make it
  1. Blend a glass of chilled milk with a banana.
  2. Add two spoons of DateGo Cocoa and a few ice cubes.
  3. Blend until smooth and pour.

Makhana chips chaat

10 minutes, serves 2

How to make it
  1. Spread masala makhana chips on a plate.
  2. Top with chopped onion, tomato and coriander.
  3. Finish with green chutney and a pinch of chaat masala.

Questions, answered.

Can't find what you need? Send us a message and the right team will reply.

How do I place a bulk or wholesale order?

Add products and quantities to your enquiry list and send it, or use the contact form. The supply team will share pricing based on volume and location.

Can I customise corporate gift boxes?

Yes. Use the gift builder to choose a box, pick the contents and add a logo sleeve or greeting card. For fully custom boxes, request a quote.

Do you work with buyers outside India?

Send an export or private-label enquiry with your country, products and expected volumes, and our team will come back with options.

When does supply start?

We are preparing to open supply. Send an enquiry now and our team will contact you with pricing and availability as soon as orders open.

How can I support AIVAR Foundation?

Choose "Pledge support" in the Foundation section, or tick the Foundation box when you send an enquiry. Companies can also sponsor meals as part of CSR plans.

Can I hire staff for a short period?

Yes. AIVAR Workforce offers short-term staff for events and festive peaks, contract staffing and permanent placement.

Tell us what you need.

Bulk orders, supply contracts, gifting, packaging, staffing or Foundation partnerships. Our team will get back to you.
